interpolation: linear: no cubic overshoot beyond keyed anatomy
limits: Body acting only; independent facial expressions, scarf cloth, carried note and recipe page need dedicated artwork.
No clip mutates gameplay or implies successful physical interaction.

distract.description: Look left, sweep the empty hand wide, glance back while the prop hand stays low.

place_prop.description: Bend with both hands, lower the held prop, release and straighten.

concealed_panic.description: Quick side glances and hands pressed inward, then a deliberately composed recovery.

genuine_surprise.description: Compress before a startled rise, open both hands and settle.

rescue_react.description: Reach to steady a safely arrived traveller, look down, then give a relieved nod.

land.description: Wings brake the descent, feet extend and the body settles through a small landing bounce.

scarf.description: Reach toward the satchel and wrap the wings at the neck; scarf cloth awaits its separate art.

hide.description: Fold both wings protectively around the face and cautiously re-emerge.

sleepy.description: Slow drooping antennae and head, a tiny startle, then back into the same drowsy posture.

carry_note.description: Lift carefully with both feet together, balance the satchel and offer the carried note; separate note art remains.

inspect_rope.description: Lift and turn the coil, follow the rope with the eyes, then lower it.

pull_mooring.description: Reach forward, plant weight back and give the mooring a firm two-hand pull.

arms_crossed.description: Bring the forearms across the apron, hold a patient appraisal, then release.

restrained_laugh.description: A contained shoulder laugh, small head dip and a calm settling pause.

measure.description: Extend the wooden rule, sight along it, adjust its angle and fold back.

crouch_inspect.description: Lower into a grounded inspection crouch, look under the mechanism, rise without translating feet.

glasses_wipe.description: Raise one glove to the spectacle area, make a short wiping arc and lower it; separate glasses are not rigged.

point_method.description: A quick clear extended arm toward the exposed method, followed by a firm recovery.

thoughtful_nod.description: Consider first, give one deep and one shallow nod while the rule stays still.

notebook_draw.description: Hold the notebook at chest level, draw several small strokes and inspect the sketch.

lean_forward.description: Shift curiosity forward with the notebook held out of the way, then return to balance.

raised_hand.description: An eager high hand above the head, held long enough to read, then lowered.

small_hop.description: Small anticipation, joyful hop and soft landing; feet do not leave their logical slot.

protect_notes.description: Draw the notebook safely into the chest and turn the shoulders away from the disturbance.

taste.description: Lift the copper spoon, pause to taste, consider and lower it.

kettle_check.description: Lean over the kettle area and test with the spoon, keeping a cautious distance.

apron_shake.description: Lift the apron sides and shake out a little flour in two broad beats.

recipe_flip.description: Hold an imagined recipe at chest level and turn a page; the missing page prop remains an art limitation.

delighted_plan.description: An idea arrives: lift the head, open both hands generously, then nod at the new plan.

inspect.description: Inspect from one angle, pause, then compare a second angle while the folder stays upright.

page_turn.description: Steady the folder and move the free hand across it to turn one page.

stamp_check.description: Inspect the administrative stamp, lift, press once against the folder and recover; no game-law callback.

eyebrow_raise.description: Reserved questioning head tilt with a long appraisal hold; independent eyebrow artwork remains missing.

approval_smile.description: Tiny approving nod and relaxed arms; the fixed painted mouth does not become a facial smile.

grand_entrance.description: Gather the cape, open a grand two-arm presentation, let the hat ribbon overshoot and settle.

premature_bow.description: Bow too confidently, hold, then lift the head suddenly to check whether applause has started.

ribbon_tangle.description: The hat ribbon swings across his head; he catches at it, disentangles and regains composure.

honest_help.description: Step out of presentation mode and extend both hands low to support someone else’s work.

shared_bow.description: Invite a partner with one open arm and bow together at a gentler, respectful pace.

walk.description: A four-legged diagonal walk with a grounded rise/fall and delayed bell swing.

idle_chew.description: Small chewing head beats and a relaxed tail swish; no independently deforming jaw is present.

sniff.description: Extend the muzzle, take two small inquisitive sniffs, then pull back.

nibble_attempt.description: Reach to the paper, try two tiny nibbles, then withdraw; never modifies paper state.

surprised_stop.description: Plant the front hooves, lift the muzzle abruptly and let the bell finish its swing.

cargo_balance.description: Counterbalance a rocking load with four planted hooves and an opposing head motion.

safe_rescue.description: A relieved little bound only after safe arrival, with four-foot recovery and bell follow-through.

satisfied.description: Lift the chin proudly, swish the tail, then give a contented final nod.
